# Install layout contract — removal safety

The uninstaller removes ONLY entries it created: each managed key is matched by JSON pointer AND the SHA-256 recorded at install time. A neighbour tool's entry under the same parent object is never touched, even when the parent was created by us. Orphan reaping walks recorded anchors only; a path outside the recorded anchor set is refused.
